name: poststruct
description: Audit what shipped. A zero-dependency CLI that walks baked HTML and verifies head, links, and site hygiene against a contract - FAIL findings exit non-zero so CI gates regressions.

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node test/version-truth.mjs && node test/shapes-run.mjs && node --test test/ship-from-download.test.cjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint:packs && npm run conform:packs && npm run lint:docs
scripts.site:build: npm --prefix web run build && rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp -r web/dist/. dist/
scripts.lint:docs: node scripts/check-docs-frontmatter.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-links.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-style.cjs && node scripts/check-fiction-signatures.cjs && node scripts/check-jekyll-filters.cjs && node scripts/check-language.cjs
